reasons.N2: temperature_range: Rotation: Herring et al. 1986 measured the S-line widths at 80, 195 and 295 K and fitted their power law over 80-295 K (their Eq. (9), 'better than 3 % over the range of 80-300 K', p. 7); above 295 K the law is extrapolated. Vibration: Rosasco et al. 1983 at 298 K and Rahn & Palmer 1986 at 500-1500 K.
reasons.N2: shifts: No N2 line shifts are used: Rosasco et al. 1983 (p. 438) report the Q-branch shifts below 0.001 cm-1/atm, under 1 % of the widths' coefficients (0.06-0.13 cm-1/atm, FWHM) (TC-688).

reasons.H2: temperature_range: Rotation: Herring et al. 1986's S(0) and S(1) widths at 80 and 295 K. Vibration: Bischel & Dyer 1986's Eq. (2), 77-500 K.
reasons.H2: vibrational_shift: Bischel & Dyer 1986's Eq. (4), the Q(1) self-shift, -96.1 MHz/amagat at 298 K (the shift is 1.85 times the collisional width's coefficient, 51.8 MHz/amagat), used for every Q(J) as the width law is (their Q(0) shift is -64 MHz/amagat at 298 K, Table II; Q(0) holds 13 % of the molecules at 295 K). The S lines shift by +6 MHz/amagat (Herring et al. Table VI), 5 % of their widths' coefficient: not used (TC-688).
